title: Тарелки на счастье  (Smashing Plates for Good Luck)

segments.t: As the wedding party arrives at Claude Monet, a boisterous guest begins hurling plates onto the floor and shouting 'For good luck!' Chef Barinov orders the staff to add every broken plate to the bill, while Kostya warns Max in the hallway that the Chef will kill him if he spots him.

Шеф реально тебя прибьет, если увидит.
Пока я с ним нормально не поговорю.

'I was just informed a moment ago.' In Russian, the idea of 'for me' flows naturally into 'to inform' without extra filler words.
'For good luck!' Notice how Russian expresses 'on' and 'joy' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Well, of course, for good luck!' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'come on', while 'joy' completes the thought. Kostya answers right away.
'Smash away to your heart's content!' The meaning hinges on 'to beat' working together with 'health' in spoken Russian.

'Put all of that good luck straight onto his bill.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to drive in' before landing on 'expense'.
'He is going to smash every dish we have.' The grammar packs 'all' and 'to smash' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'You should not have come back here, pal.' The meaning hinges on 'for nothing' working together with 'old man' in spoken Russian.

'The Chef will literally kill you if he sees you.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'chef' and 'really' in a few short words.
'I am not going to leave him alone.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'to fall behind' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.

'Not until I have a proper talk with him.' In Russian, the idea of 'for now' flows naturally into 'I'll talk' without extra filler words.
'You will get lucky one day too.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'to be lucky'.
'I have already gotten lucky.' In Russian, the idea of 'for me' flows naturally into 'it was lucky' without extra filler words. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
